description: Default dependency policy for repositories maintained by xlionjuan.

customManagers.description: Update opt-in Git refs stored as immutable 40-character SHA variables. Git SHA and digest updates do not reliably support minimumReleaseAge, so the three-day cooldown is best effort for these updates.

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major trusted Actions after checks pass. Renovate normalizes both GitHub syntax (actions/checkout@...) and explicit Forgejo URLs (https://git.xlion.tw/actions/checkout@...) to packageName actions/checkout, so actions/* covers both forms.
Require Dependency Dashboard approval before opening Dockerfile or Containerfile image digest pinning PRs.
This image intentionally tracks latest and resolves and verifies one digest at workflow runtime. Renovate must not pin or otherwise update it.
